errors.evidence: The Y-axis range is from -25 to 225, not from 0 to 225.
The blue line representing Bulgaria starts at a value of approximately 110-115% in 1980, not 125%.
The phrase 'вълнуваща тенденция' (exciting trend) is subjective and interpretive, not a factual description of the line's fluctuation.

errors.text_span: с върхове около 200% в края на 1990-те години
errors.evidence: The peak for the Bulgaria line is significantly higher than 200% (closer to 220%) and occurs in the mid-1990s (around 1994), not at the end of the decade.
The Bulgaria line ends at approximately 25% in 2015, not 30%.

errors.text_span: се поддържа на ниво 25% през целия период
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the OECD line is maintained at 25%. The figure clearly shows this line is constant at the 0% level throughout the entire period.
